title: Human-AI collaborative autonomous synthesis with pulsed laser deposition for remote epitaxy

live_model.evidence: "The LLM was accessed through the OpenAI Responses API using the GPT-5 snapshot gpt-5-2025-08-07 with high reasoning effort enabled (thinking mode). Generation was performed with a temperature of 0.3" (Methods, Retrieval Augmented Generation)

prompt.location: Methods (RAG pipeline: 345 articles chunked/embedded, top-50 chunks appended to query)

notes: Materials-science/robotics paper. GPT-5 functions as a literature-QA assistant within a larger human/Bayesian-optimization decision loop; no accuracy or task-success number is attributed to GPT-5's own text generation specifically.
